consequence.statement: Requests from frontend v2 to querier via scheduler are now transmitted as pure Protobuf instead of wrapped when -frontend.encoding=protobuf is configured.

original.statement: When -frontend.encoding=protobuf is set, Loki frontend v2 now sends pure Protobuf requests through the scheduler to the querier instead of wrapping them.

decision.reason: [ev-3f7dccc9a7e0] says only that when `-frontend.encoding=protobuf` is set, frontend v2 now sends plain Protobuf requests to the querier via the scheduler, instead of wrapping them. It is listed as a feature. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs migrating, so a failure kind is not supported. Low-severity behavior-change (review) fits what the evidence says.
